node.statement: Fix an arbitrary def-stage1-polar-witness-data tuple W satisfying C_rect >= c and 0 < e_rect <= min{e,1/C_rect}, and an arbitrary finite-dimensional epsilon_X-C*-algebra with 0 <= epsilon_X <= e_rect. Then epsilon_X <= e_rect <= e, so the external producer applies. Moreover epsilon_X >= 0 and C_rect >= c imply 0 <= alpha:=c*epsilon_X <= beta:=C_rect*epsilon_X.
